the bias analysis is a powerful tool for text classification, and the bias analysis can be used to select appropriate classifiers for highly skewed data.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
feature selection metrics should not be used in isolation for text classification.
we should select a metric that can balance the metric and class biases, and use a classifier that can balance classifier bias.
the performance of the classifiers can be improved by using the metric of bi-normalseparation for feature selection and the classifier bias for selecting the classifier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
feature selection is not necessarily a good practice for highly skewed data, and the bias in feature selection can be exploited to achieve good classification results.
the bias analysis can be applied to understand the performance of classifiers and to improve the classification performance.
